insight: Popularized reference-free RAG metrics — faithfulness, context precision — scored by an LLM judge, so you evaluate without gold answers.
name: Ragas
tagline: Open-source evaluation toolkit for RAG and LLM applications.
description: Open-source (Apache-2.0) Python framework for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation and LLM apps. Provides reference-free metrics — faithfulness, answer relevancy, context precision/recall — plus knowledge-graph-based synthetic test generation. Integrates with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and CI pipelines.

modelSupport.notes: Bring any provider/model for the LLM-as-judge metrics.
